classification: qualification evidence for model-inferred continental material; not exposed land, palaeoshoreline, or topography

coverage.comparisonLimit: Denominators sum Cao spherical target-part areas; the delivered numerator is an equal-area simplified union. These are scale indicators, not exact set coverage or a claim that unfilled target area lacks continental crust.

309.derivation: intersect the immutable Cao West Svalbard target union with the separately authored West Svalbard closed continental boundary whose native validity reaches 600 Ma, inset 1500 m, and simplify 500 m with topology preservation

311.derivation: intersect the immutable Cao East Svalbard target union with the separately authored East Svalbard closed continental boundary whose native validity reaches 600 Ma, inset 1500 m, and simplify 500 m with topology preservation

geometryProcessing.operation: intersect each exact Cao Svalbard target with its matching valid-to-600 Ma closed continental boundary, inset 1500 m, and simplify 500 m with topology preservation
geometryProcessing.projection: spherical Lambert azimuthal equal-area centered at 15E, 78N
geometryProcessing.toleranceSelectionRule: fixed per-cohort target/boundary expansion rules; preliminary NPI simplification ladder remains only as affinity-witness qualification history

overlapMethod: centroid/vertex results are screens only; acceptance and interpretation use the accompanying union/intersection area measurements
